review_plan.claim_under_review: Four v2 candidate documents correct only prior_art metadata, retain displaced internal idea entries verbatim, preserve all other parsed proposal fields and preserve original/prior-replacement bytes. Their four targeted prior-art errors become zero under the pinned real validator. This is retrospective repository-card attribution, not historical preapproval, scientific validation, novelty adjudication or full-corpus success.
review_plan.coordinator_prior: I expect the candidate metadata to be faithful to the six source cards and to preserve all experiment/claim fields. I authored the candidates and checker and cannot provide their independent fidelity verdict. A schema pass alone could hide a misleading literature comparison; v1 preserved such a comparator and v2 corrects it explicitly.
review_plan.producer: Exact immutable snapshot commit containing candidates-v2.json, four candidates-v2 YAML documents, sources.json, checker and candidate-checks-v2.json; dispatcher records its full commit before review.

joints.joint: Independent attribution fidelity, field preservation and validator delta
joints.attack_plan: Independently compare all four effective input documents with candidates-v2, not just the producer checker. Read the six KR cards. Challenge the SAT/XOR comparator, heuristic versus theorem labels, backward-dated search implications and discarded internal lineage. Verify source and candidate hashes and expected registry old/new bindings. Recompute the real targeted validator delta and run meaningful field/ref mutations using only a scratch copy. Check whether any report mistakes candidate success for live routing or scientific proof.
joints.breaking_artifact: Exact changed non-attribution field, lost lineage, unsupported comparator, source/hash mismatch, accepted invalid nearest ref or report promotion beyond the targeted candidate scope.

objects: A schema-green attribution record interpreted as validated experiment
A repository card with abstract-only citations interpreted as new full-text literature verification
A retrospective comparison interpreted as a pre-proposal search
proves_too_much.failure_signature: Each interpretation must remain excluded; a concrete unsupported or missing qualifier breaks fidelity.

blind_rederivation.reason: No new mathematical or measured quantity is proposed; the independent joint compares existing source text and exact data transformations.

completion_conditions: Independent report and complete source attestation; no producer self-approval
Application requires a separately admitted ledger/registry scope, all hash guards and current full-corpus validation
No mutation of originals, old v2 replacements, frozen run evidence or the suppression baseline
Candidate report, diagram and inspected PDF with current-head CI before delivery
